Which questions stay
• First install: Android asks once for every new app. That is Android’s rule for every store.
• Updates (Android 12 and newer): apps that Koulaxizis Apps installed update without a question, one by one or with Update all.
• Apps installed elsewhere (browser, F-Droid, Droid-ify): the first update here asks once (“Android asks once more”); after it, Koulaxizis Apps is their installer and later updates go without a question.
• Android 11 and older: every update asks.
• Some phones (Xiaomi, Redmi, POCO) add their own check or question on top; Koulaxizis Apps cannot turn it off.

Automatic updates (menu, off at first)
Twice a day, on Wi-Fi and with enough battery, the daily check installs the updates that need no question. The others wait in the notification. Koulaxizis Apps never shows a question by itself and never updates itself this way.

Install without questions (Shizuku) (menu, off at first)
Shizuku is a free app that lets other apps use the rights of Android’s developer tools, without root. With it, first installs go without a question too. Every app is still checked (repository signature, size, SHA-256, signing key) before it is installed.
1. Install Shizuku (shizuku.rikka.app).
2. Turn on Developer options and Wireless debugging (Android 11+), then start Shizuku from its own screen. After each restart of the phone, start it again.
3. Here, turn on Install without questions (Shizuku) and allow it.
When Shizuku is not running, installs go the normal way with Android’s question.

Google Play Protect
On phones with Google Play, Play Protect may ask to scan an app that does not come from the Play Store, or warn about it. Koulaxizis Apps never bypasses or hides Play Protect. If you want, you can turn its scan off yourself: Play Store › your profile picture › Play Protect › ⚙ › Scan apps with Play Protect. Then Google no longer checks any app on the phone; you can turn it back on at any time. Our apps are signed with our own key, and Koulaxizis Apps checks every file before Android installs it.

Koulaxizis Apps is free software (MIT). It uses the Shizuku API by RikkaW (Apache-2.0, github.com/RikkaApps/Shizuku-API).
